Docs.summary: The password for the virtual machine administrator account. The password must be 8 to 123 characters long for Windows virtual machines or 6 to 72 characters long for Linux virtual machines. It must contain characters from at least three of these categories: lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, and special characters. The following values are not allowed: `abc@123`, `P@$$w0rd`, `P@ssw0rd`, `P@ssword123`, `Pa$$word`, `pass@word1`, `Password!`, `Password1`, `Password22`, and `iloveyou!`. This secret is accepted only in the request and is not returned in responses.
